    for b in bs:
        if abs(b)<1e-9: continue
        with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
            F=f(b)
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(F)): continue
        val,c=lin_nmse(F,q)
        if val>best[0]: best=(val,b,c)
    print(f'{name:26s} 1-R2={1-best[0]:.3e} b={best[1]:.3f}', np.round(best[2],3) if best[2] is not None else '')
